entities.summary: Vitaliy Ivanovich Lytvynenko, is a Ukrainian retired professional ice hockey player. He played for multiple teams in both Ukraine and Russia during his career, which lasted from 1987 until 2015. He played internationally for the Ukrainian national team at several World Championships, as well as the 2002 Winter Olympics.
